name: Colombia
description: Follow Colombia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Magnitude 7.4 quake rocks western Colombia, killing at least 111 people
changes.summary: Search teams and civilians picked through the remains of destroyed buildings in the country's third-largest city, Cali, passing large pieces of concrete and rubble down a long line of volunteers. (Image credit: Santiago Saldarriaga).

changes.title: Videos capture the moment a 7.4-magnitude earthquake strikes Colombia
changes.summary: Watch videos captured from Colombia as a 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck the country. Casualties have been reported with many still missing amid the collapsed buildings and debris.

changes.title: 7.4-magnitude earthquake rocks Colombia, crumbling homes and buildings
changes.summary: A powerful and deadly earthquake hit Colombia on Monday, killing at least 111 people, toppling buildings and leaving a trail of destruction. Geoff Bennett reports.

changes.title: Search for survivors underway after 7.4-magnitude earthquake hits Colombia
changes.summary: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake rattled western Colombia, causing buildings to collapse and setting off a search for survivors. NBC News’ George Solis reports on the developing situation and an early assessment of the damage.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: Colombia first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Colombia's new president vows to remake the country — and challenge its fragile peace
changes.summary: A new political era for Colombia: a hard-right president promises order, growth and confrontation. (Image credit: John Vizcaino).

changes.title: Trump Administration Fast-Tracks Military Partnership With Colombia to Target Drug Traffickers
changes.summary: The country’s new Trump-endorsed president takes office on Friday. Sweeping plans to target drug traffickers with U.S. help are already underway.
